name: Psilocybin
tierNotes: Threshold: colors slightly deeper, especially greens and ambers (early colorSat only).
Light: slow large-scale breathing begins; period noticeably longer than LSD's.
Common: melt visibly begins — surfaces slump on the ~20 s accumulator cycle; water-ripple sheen from the brightest light.
Strong: full slumping surfaces, edges wiggle organically, olive/amber convergence obvious.

Heavy: the whole scene turns molten and flows like wet paint. On top of the doubled melt-slump, a large slow fbm domain-warp swims organically and drips downward (~5% of frame) so the room liquefies while staying the room; colours melt and bleed richer (earth convergence + organic glow swell at the deep end) with strong pattern bleed-through. Deliberately unlike DMT: no crystalline geometry, no tunnel, no replacement — everything is smooth, liquid and legible, just molten.
